Co-usage of nearby initiation zones

Source: R/iz_heterogeneity_downstream.R
compute_nearby_iz_associations.Rd

For every pair of IZs on the same chromosome with centres at most max_distance apart, correlate their usage across cells after removing the replication-progress trend (correct_signal_matrix()); pairs with fewer than min_complete complete cells or constant residuals get NA. P-values (t-test of the correlation) are BH-adjusted; significant pairs are "co_usage" (positive) or "competition" (negative), others "neutral".

Usage

compute_nearby_iz_associations(
  usage,
  progress,
  iz_metadata,
  max_distance = 1e+06,
  correction = c("bin", "spline"),
  n_progress_bins = 10L,
  spline_df = 4L,
  min_complete = 30L,
  fdr_threshold = 0.05,
  BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam()
)

Arguments

usage

Cells x IZs usage matrix with IZ ids as column names.

progress

Replication progress of the cells.

iz_metadata

Table with IZ_id, chr and center.

max_distance

Maximum centre distance (bp).

correction, n_progress_bins, spline_df

Trend-correction settings.

min_complete

Minimum number of complete cells.

fdr_threshold

FDR threshold.

BPPARAM

A BiocParallel::BiocParallelParam used over chromosomes.

Value

A data.frame of pairs: chr, IZ1, IZ2, distance, association, p_value, n_cells, FDR, association_type and distance_bin.
